name: G H Raisoni University, Chhindwara

assets.description: Official full-colour G H Raisoni University Saikheda wordmark with purple lettering and gold emblem
assets.alt: G H Raisoni University Saikheda full-colour logo
assets.identity_evidence: Raisoni Education RUCET admissions portal explicitly identifies G H Raisoni University Saikheda, its 13 June 2016 founding and Madhya Pradesh campus, and directly references this ghrus.webp logo. The logo visibly says Saikheda and matches the lion emblem and wordmark of the university official-site white variant. The portal supplies Raisoni institutional email contacts and Raisoni policy links.
assets.notes: Original official full-colour WebP bytes downloaded unchanged. Visually inspected on white; purple wording and gold emblem remain visible. No recolouring, cropping, background insertion or upscaling. Replaces the white wordmark for CMS import.
